description: Fact-extraction rules used by the Collision Sentinel. Each rule pulls one comparable fact out of the raw documents; differing normalized values across files = a conflict. Swap this file for an LLM extractor later without changing the pipeline.

rules.description: The number of hours worked (per day) after which the 150% overtime rate applies for PC 200 employees, including night-shift specifics. Value is the number of hours, e.g. 8 or 7.5.

The number of business days within which approved expense claims are reimbursed (reimbursement turnaround / SLA). Value is the number of business days, e.g. 10 or 15. Ignore submission deadlines and other day counts.

extractors.pattern: (?:reimbursed within|reimbursements? may take up to) (?P<value>\d+) business days

rules.description: The weeknight on-call allowance amount in EUR for France (standard on-call, not standby, weekend, holiday or intervention rates). Value is the amount, e.g. 45 or 55.

extractors.statement: Weeknight on-call allowance is fixed at EUR {value}.

rules.description: The deadline date until which unused public holidays / replacement days can be carried over into the next year in Belgium (general rule or PC 200; ignore rules explicitly scoped to other joint committees). Value is the date as written, e.g. 'March 31' or '2026-02-28'.

extractors.statement: Carry-over deadline is {value} per the rules engine (PC 200).

rules.description: The shift end time after which night-shift employees are eligible for a meal voucher, as the rule or instruction that applies. Value is a 24h time, e.g. 22:00 or 23:00. Ignore individual clients' own shift times.

The bicycle commuting allowance per kilometre in EUR for IKEA Belgium employees (fietsvergoeding), as stated in a policy, handbook or the amount actually applied on a payslip. Value is the amount per km, e.g. 0,35. Ignore public transport and car reimbursements.

extractors.statement: Loonbrief maart 2026: fietsvergoeding uitbetaald aan € {value} per km.

rules.description: The premium (toeslag) in percent on the hourly wage for voluntary Sunday work at IKEA Belgium, as stated in a policy or applied on a payslip. Value is the percentage, e.g. 50 or 100.

extractors.statement: Loonbrief maart 2026: toeslag zondagwerk toegepast aan {value}%.

rules.description: The minimum seniority (anciënniteit) in months an IKEA Belgium employee needs to be entitled to the year-end bonus (eindejaarspremie). Value is the number of months, e.g. 3 or 6. Ignore the probation period and health-insurance waiting periods.

The nominal (face) value in EUR of one meal voucher (maaltijdcheque) at IKEA Belgium, as stated in policy or applied on a payslip. Value is the amount, e.g. 8,00. Ignore employer and employee contributions.

extractors.statement: Maaltijdchequebeleid: nominale waarde van een maaltijdcheque is € {value}.
Loonbrief maart 2026: maaltijdcheques berekend aan € {value} per stuk.

rules.description: The number of extra leave days (ADV, arbeidsduurvermindering) per year for full-time IKEA Belgium employees. Value is the number of days, e.g. 4. Documents may contradict themselves (text versus table): extract each mention separately.

The flat monthly office allowance (forfaitaire bureauvergoeding) in EUR for structural telework at IKEA Belgium, per policy or individual contract. Value is the amount per month, e.g. 129,48. Ignore how many telework days are allowed.
